import ast,json,sqlite3,traceback,contextlib
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace as N
B=Path('.dedup-work/immich12-20261021')
log=N(**{k:lambda *a,**kw:None for k in ['info','warn','error']})
def extract(path,names,env,assigns=()):
 t=ast.parse((B/path).read_text());t.body=[ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__',names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')],level=0)]+[x for x in t.body if isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) and x.name in names or isinstance(x,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(v,ast.Name) and v.id in assigns for v in x.targets)];ast.fix_missing_locations(t);exec(compile(t,str(B/path),'exec'),env);return env
E=extract('src--db--pics.py',{'saveBy','_migrateSims'},dict(json=json,lg=log,BaseDictModel=N(jsonSerializer=str),mkErr=lambda msg,e=None:RuntimeError(f'{msg}: {e}')),['_SCHEMAS'])
c=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
for table,schema in E['_SCHEMAS'].items(): c.execute(f'CREATE TABLE {table} ({schema})')
payload=dict(id='owned-fixture',ownerId='owner',originalPath='a.jpg',thumbnail_path='thumb.jpg',fileCreatedAt='2020-01-01',originalFileName='a.jpg',isFavorite=0,exifInfo={'exifImageWidth':100})
assert E['saveBy'](payload,c.cursor())==1
c.execute('UPDATE assets SET isVectored=1,simOk=1');c.execute('INSERT INTO assetsSims VALUES (1,1,1,1)')
payload['fileCreatedAt']='2021-02-02';payload['originalFileName']='renamed.jpg'
rst=E['saveBy'](payload,c.cursor());row=c.execute('SELECT * FROM assets').fetchone();out={'metadata_only_update':{'result':rst,'stored_date':row['fileCreatedAt'],'stored_name':row['originalFileName']}}
assert rst==0 and row['fileCreatedAt']=='2020-01-01'
payload['thumbnail_path']='new-thumbnail.jpg';assert E['saveBy'](payload,c.cursor())==2
row=c.execute('SELECT * FROM assets').fetchone();out['changed_thumbnail_state']={'isVectored':row['isVectored'],'simOk':row['simOk'],'similarity_rows':c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM assetsSims').fetchone()[0]};assert row['isVectored']==1 and row['simOk']==1
c.execute("ALTER TABLE assets ADD COLUMN simGIDs TEXT DEFAULT '[]'");c.execute("ALTER TABLE assets ADD COLUMN simInfos TEXT DEFAULT '[]'");c.execute("INSERT INTO libraries (id,name,importPaths) VALUES ('lib','owned-library','[]')");c.commit()
E['_migrateSims'](c);out['legacy_migration_library_count']=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM libraries').fetchone()[0];assert out['legacy_migration_library_count']==0
c.close()

events=[]

 def __enter__(self):return self
 def __exit__(self,*args):return False
 def cursor(self):return self
 def commit(self):events.append('external_commit')
def localfail(*args): events.append('local_delete_failed');raise RuntimeError('injected local write failure')

sto=N(nfy=N(error=lambda msg:events.append('error_reported'),success=lambda msg:None),now=N(sim=N(assCur=assets,clearAll=lambda:events.append('view_cleared'))),ste=N(getSelected=lambda all:[all[1]],clear=lambda:events.append('selection_cleared')))
T=extract('src--pages--similar.py',{'sim_SelectedDelete'},dict(db=N(dto=N(mrg=N(on=False)),pics=N(deleteBy=localfail)),psql=N(mkConn=Conn),immich=N(trashByAssets=lambda a,cur:events.append('external_trash_mock'),restoreXmpBak=lambda a:None),lg=log,traceback=traceback))
try:T['sim_SelectedDelete'](lambda *a:None,sto)
except RuntimeError:pass
out['injected_local_delete_failure']=events;assert events[:3]==['external_trash_mock','external_commit','local_delete_failed']
(B/'controls-v2-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
findings: Original saveBy returns unchanged for updates limited to fileCreatedAt/originalFileName: stored date/name remain old. Those fields are used by filtering/group conditions elsewhere.

Original saveBy updates thumbnail path but preserves isVectored=1,simOk=1 and old similarity relation rows. External caller invalidation remains to be inspected; this test establishes function boundary only.

Original _migrateSims drops/recreates libraries but never reads/restores their contents; owned in-memory legacy migration loses one library row. Asset migration itself executed with schemas from original source.

Original sim_SelectedDelete fake trace confirms external trash+commit before local delete failure; failure handler clears view and selection. No cross-store transaction/compensation for already committed external trash in this handler; only XMP backup restore if available.
SQLite mkConn enables FK and commits explicitly in callers. Local SQLite rollback cannot undo completed external vector/database writes. Source finding; not live service qualification.

setSimInfos rejects empty infos, deletes/reinserts relations in local transaction, then sets simOk; per-root group/infos updates use independent connections/commits. Entire traversal is not a single transaction.
getSimAssets incGroup computes root dot products for sorting but does not threshold-prune expanded members. On vector-processing exception it returns unsorted assets; no all-pairs duplicate proof.
countFiltered/getFiltered/getAssetsByGID/getPagedPending catch DB errors as zero/empty, collapsing errors into no results; settings get similarly returns default.
Cnt.reset omits simNo while clearing other counters; Gws.dtc uses time.time at class definition rather than per-instance factory. Source observations.
Asset.getImagePath relies on configured thumbnail/preview selection and raises if missing; originalPath content identity is not verified here.
